stories.title: New Cat Species Identified for the First Time in Over 100 Years — Meet the Tilcayo
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: Scientists have confirmed a brand-new species of wild cat, found high in the mountains of Bolivia. Named the Tilcayo, it's smaller than the average housecat and had never been formally recognized by science before now. This is the first time in over a century that a new cat species has been identified anywhere in the world. It's a wonderful reminder that our planet still holds surprises, and that there are dedicated explorers out there finding them.
stories.why_good: A genuine, verified scientific discovery of a new mammal species is happening-now good news for biodiversity, with no political angle at all.

stories.title: Cataract Surgery Restores Sight for 54-Year-Old Chimpanzee at Chimp Haven
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: A 54-year-old chimpanzee named Pierre had gone completely blind from cataracts at Chimp Haven, the world's largest chimpanzee sanctuary. Veterinary teams performed the sanctuary's first-ever cataract surgery on him, and it worked. Pierre can now see again and is adjusting well back with his troop. It's a small but touching reminder of how far animal care has come, giving an elderly chimp his sight back in his golden years.
stories.why_good: A real, completed medical procedure that restored a suffering animal's quality of life, with no tragedy or loss at its core.

stories.title: Company’s Textile Dyes Work Through Magnetism, Cutting Fashion’s Water-Use, Energy, and Pollution
stories.label: earth
stories.summary: A French startup has invented a completely new way to dye fabric, using magnetism instead of the usual hot, chemical-heavy vats. The dyeing process is responsible for about half of all fashion-industry emissions, so this is a big deal. Their method works at room temperature, uses far less water and energy, and skips toxic chemicals altogether. The color still lasts just as long as traditional dye. It's a real, working product already cutting fashion's environmental footprint, not just a lab idea.
stories.why_good: A real, already-functioning invention that cuts water use, energy use, and toxic pollution in one of the world's dirtiest industries.
